rites.name: Gragar
rites.text: Gragar is the hum that the first roots of Vaurnes gave off as they gathered into soil during the Singing, a concept rather than a being. It is remembered as the pressure that split bedrock so that the earliest groves could take hold.

rites.name: Listum
rites.text: Listum is the concept of resonance itself as it was heard in the Singing, when the first roots of Vaurnes condensed out of sound. In the Holy Age the temple orders taught that every flame and every bell was a branch of this single chord.

rites.name: Syethora
rites.text: Syethora is the concept of resonance itself as it bound the early roots of Vaurnes during the Singing, a sounding that ran through the world before any age was counted. In the Age of Sundering, when landfall broke the old bonds between the roots, Syethora was the note that held the fractures from collapsing into silence.

rites.name: Caurnes
rites.text: Caurnes is the concept of the Weave, the thread the makers plant during the Seeding to hold quiet powers asleep until the right hour. In the Age of the first sovereign it is felt as a steady hum beneath groves and growing kingdoms, a promise rather than a force.

rites.name: Ukalaoma
rites.text: Ukalaoma is a concept in the Vaurnes cosmology, a quiet power that the makers plant into the Weave during the Seeding, lying dormant until the Age of Sundering. When landfall fractured the old bonds between peoples and their shaping forces, Ukalaoma was the thread that pulled the broken ties back together.

rites.name: Drureston
rites.text: Drureston is a concept in Vaurnes, born in the Fall when the worlds broke and the Pact was sworn. It names the living root-bond that held the first groves together through the Sundering. It is remembered as the thread that let growing kingdoms survive the Shards.

rites.name: Corireonia
rites.text: Corireonia is a solitary tradition of Vaurnes in which practitioners ride the hedges between waking and dream, returning with herb-lore and small charms. Its adepts keep no covens, trusting only their own steady hands and whatever the roots and ravens tell them.

rites.name: Tiantor
rites.text: Tiantor is a dark glass lens of the Vaurnes age that gathers the hush of distant rooms and lets a gazer see them. Its visions carry a quiet cost, since whatever it shows must be paid for in the viewer's remembered days. It is said to bloom only when the Mythic realm's tides run low.

rites.name: Oriraullus
rites.text: Oriraullus is a hand-sized lens of cloudy crystal that Vaurnes's hedge-seers pass between their palms to glimpse threads of what is yet to come. Its sight carries no force of its own, yet a seer who gazes too long into its depths can unmake the very future it reveals.
